The single bullet sends you to Ru'Lude Gardens to 'approach the palace doors'. That is a common-noun phrase with a definite article, not a name, so per AUTHORING's first hard rule the target is the ZONE and not an invented entity. I checked before deciding: the resolver accepts any NPC string (it only folds and tests for ambiguity), so it cannot adjudicate this, and the shipped index's 'palace door' / 'palace doors' keys both belong to zone 50 entities in Aht Urhgan Whitegate, while the only palace entity it knows in Ru'Lude Gardens (243) is the bare key 'palace' scraped from a CoP page's Start field. Borrowing either would be a name this page never wrote, aimed at a zone the index does not put it in. So the step keeps its rung, names the zone, and carries no marker -- which is what this mission has today (its chronicle row is snpc='' with one empty-NPC rung), so nothing is lost. Expect stage C to raise start_npc_unresolved and pin the record at low for exactly this reason; that is correct, not a misreading. The sub-bullet warning that several cutscenes play here and that the right one has you speaking with Trion is a disambiguation for the player and is kept in the note rather than made a rung.
